\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{scope}[xshift=3pt]
    \clip (-3pt,-2pt) rectangle (7pt,8pt);
    \begin{scope}[on background layer]
      \fill[blue] (-30pt,-40pt) rectangle (40pt,60pt);
    \end{scope}
  \end{scope}
  \begin{scope}[on background layer]
    \useasboundingbox (-9pt,-3pt) rectangle (7pt,10pt);
    \fill[green] (-50pt,-40pt) rectangle (60pt,50pt);
  \end{scope}
  \fill[red] (8pt,-6pt) rectangle (12pt,3pt);
  \draw[overlay,draw=black,line width=.5pt]
    (current bounding box.south west) -- (current bounding box.north east);
\end{tikzpicture}
